en: {fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did someone teach you that?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Huh? You mean cards? How'd you know that's what I'm off to do? You're a weird one, y'know.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you often go out to have fun?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Sure. All kinds of places you've never heard of.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}And this is less than I used to, believe it or not. Back when I ran with my crew, we went pretty wild.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Where are you going now?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Gonna play a little cards.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}What? Wanna tag along? Might be a bit much for you.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}That's enough, right?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're very dedicated, aren't you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Kinda... I guess. Honestly, it's a pain.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're working hard.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yeah. I don't wanna die either.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you going to keep training today?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Yeah! I only just started.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Geez, quit askin' such dumb questions.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What kind of training are you doing?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Oh, come on! Sword trainin', obviously!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}What else would it be? Geez...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Why not rest a little?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}If restin' made me stronger, I'd be doin' it already.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I hope your training pays off soon.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yeah. That's why I keep up this trainin' junk.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Just watch. Next time we meet, I'll show you an even stronger Griffin!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like training?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}No way! If I liked it, I'd have signed up with some knights ages ago.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3380}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I hope your training pays off soon.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yeah. That's why I keep up this trainin' junk.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Just watch. Next time we meet, I'll show you an even stronger Griffin!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Is there anything else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No, not at all. Please don't worry about it, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you tired?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Thank you. I'm all right.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like traveling?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yes, I do. So many people get to hear my songs.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you getting proper rest?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yes. Though when I rest in a town square, I sometimes end up singing for the children.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How are you feeling?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Let's see. I haven't caught anything, so I'm fine.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was worried, so I came to see you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Thank you. But you don't need to worry about me so much.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's nice to walk outside, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yes, I think so too. And it's even nicer when you can hear the little birds singing.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Weren't you hoping to see me?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I was. Could it be that my song reached you, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you hungry?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}No, I'm fine. Are you all right, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's been a while, hasn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yes. It's been a long time, Angel. Have you been well?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you come across any beautiful scenery?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yes, so much of it. I wish I could show you all of it, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did I startle you, showing up so suddenly?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yes. I was surprised. I never thought you'd come all the way out here, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was wondering how you were doing.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}You were worried about me? Thank you.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:8280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}If there's anything I can do, I'll help.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Thank you, Angel. But I'm all right for now.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I thought you might have lost your way.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Thank you, Angel. It does happen sometimes, but today I'm fine.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:9680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you think about things while you walk?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Let's see... About poems.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}When I see beautiful scenery or hear the animals calling, I turn the poems that come to me into songs.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:A080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You really treasure that harp, don't you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yes, Angel. I've used this harp ever since I started singing.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It's very precious to me.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0B80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you tired?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0680}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Thank you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm all right.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Is there something else you wanted to talk about?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I hope you have sweet dreams.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yes. You came all this way to see me, Angel, so I'm sure I'll have good dreams.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Was I that much of a nuisance?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}No, not at all. Please don't worry about it, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was a little worried.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Oh, I'm all right... I'm doing well.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Don't you like staying up late?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No, I don't mind it. Sometimes I stay up all night watching the stars.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Let's do our best tomorrow too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yes, Angel. I'll do my best.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Don't you sing at night?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Well, sometimes I do.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}At night I'm sometimes invited to a noble's mansion. I sing for them there.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you take care of your harp?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yes, every night before bed. It's precious to me.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I hope you have sweet dreams.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yes. You came all this way to see me, Angel, so I'm sure I'll have good dreams.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Was there something else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Meals are fun, aren't they?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}They are. Eating something tasty really perks you up.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No, it's fine. I've already finished eating.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are there foods you don't like?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}A few. I try not to be picky, though...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you ever cook your own meals?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yes, I do. Would you like to join me sometime?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I'm getting hungry too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Why don't you go and have something to eat too, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you eating properly?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yes. I ate well. You're very kind, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Can you make songs even while eating?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Ahaha. Yes, sometimes that happens too.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Is there anything else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is something troubling you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No, it isn't that... I just love it so much when I'm singing.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Not at all. It's fine.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you tired?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}Oh... Do I look it? I have been resting properly...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You look like you're having fun.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yes. Singing calms my heart.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did someone teach you that?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}No. I've practiced little by little for a long time.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you sung ever since you were little?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yes, that's right. I've loved singing since I was small.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Singing clears my head, and somehow it makes me happy...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}May I listen from here?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Huh? Y-yes... I don't mind...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But I can't sing the songs I'm practicing very well yet... If that's all right with you.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{e5:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Was there something else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're very dedicated, aren't you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}...I can't really believe this matters that much...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But it's what I need to do to be of use to you, Angel...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're working hard.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes... Though it isn't going as well as I'd like.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you going to keep training today?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No, I think I'll stop for today after a little more.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What kind of training are you doing?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Practice holding my arms steady. With a bow or a harp, a shaky arm is no good.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Why not rest a little?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Thank you, Angel. I'll do that in a little while.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How is your combat practice going?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}My heart isn't really in it. I can't help wondering if this is truly necessary...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you confident in your stamina?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Not at all.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But I travel from town to town, so maybe my legs have gotten stronger without my noticing.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're very dedicated, aren't you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}...I can't really believe this matters that much...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But it's what I need to do to be of use to you, Angel...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}If there's anything else, I'm listening.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No, not at all. There's no need to worry about it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you tired?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Thank you for your concern. But I'm fine. I can walk a long way yet.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like traveling?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes, I do. Much of what I learn on the road is precious to me.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Still, I worry about the patients I left in Brun, so I can't make long journeys.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you getting proper rest?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Angel, I'm a doctor. I can look after myself.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I know well that overdoing it is the one thing to avoid on a journey.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How are you feeling?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes, very well.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But letting your guard down because you feel good can make you more likely to fall ill.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I must be careful.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was worried, so I came to see you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...Were you? There's no need to worry so much. I'm fine.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's nice to walk outside, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}It is.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Working as a doctor, I rarely get the chance to take a calm walk outdoors.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But walking outside like this is very important for your health.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Weren't you hoping to see me?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}...I'm not sure I follow you.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you hungry?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No. There's no need to worry. I'm fine.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
